# M2 improvement pass (auto-generated by `python -m scout.ml.tune`)

Validation data only; the test years are never loaded. Commit `64a7937-dirty`. 54 LightGBM configs and 5 ridge alphas, each scored by rolling-origin CV (fit on 2013..y-1, score y, for y = 2016–2021); the best of each family is then compared once on 2022.

**Picked:** LightGBM {'objective': 'l1', 'num_leaves': 7, 'min_child_samples': 50, 'n_estimators': 600} · ridge alpha = 100

## Where does LightGBM beat linear? (pooled CV folds 2016–2021 + 2022, both tuned)

`diff` = MAE(LightGBM) − MAE(linear); negative = LightGBM better. "yes"/"no" only when the 95% CI excludes 0.
